slides.title: What Makes Omnichannel's Promise Real
bullets: Personalization delivers the right content to the right HCP at the right moment
Replaces one generic message for the whole audience
The technical engine behind the omnichannel journey

slides.title: From Basic Profile to Predictive Signal
bullets: Basic level: specialty, facility type, approximate patient volume
Advanced level: past content consumed and questions asked
Most sophisticated: AI-enabled tools predicting relevance dynamically
Each level builds on richer data about the HCP

slides.title: Scientific Relevance, Never Commercial Potential
bullets: Personalization must rest on clinical profile and information need
Never on prescription volume or business potential
Preserves the non-promotional nature of all medical activity
Guaranteed by data governance and compliance processes

slides.title: Personalization Can Become an Echo Chamber
bullets: Only offering familiar content limits exposure to new evidence
HCPs may miss clinically valuable data they never searched for
Responsible design deliberately adds diversity and balance
Relevance alone is not enough

slides.title: The Most Nuanced Personalization Is Still Human
bullets: Personalization does not reduce the MSL's role
A direct conversation captures needs no data history predicts
MSLs recommend the exact right piece from the full content journey

takeaway.title: Content personalization delivers the right science to the right HCP, guided by need, not business potential
bullets: Personalization ranges from basic profile data to AI-driven prediction
Scientific relevance must always outrank commercial signals like prescribing volume
MSLs provide the human personalization no automated system can replicate
